title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Claims per Encounter and the Coverage Order
content:
**Policy clause.** A patient may have any number of Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)s, one per payer per billing of an encounter. An encounter carries at most one open claim per coverage order position; a secondary claim is created only after the primary claim on the same encounter is adjudicated, and a tertiary claim only after the secondary is adjudicated. A replacement for an existing claim is filed as a resubmission of that claim, never as a new claim.

There is no limit on the number of claims one patient may hold.

| Situation on one encounter | Result |
|---|---|
| Primary claim open, not yet adjudicated | no secondary claim is created |
| Primary claim adjudicated | a secondary claim may be created |
| Secondary claim adjudicated | a tertiary claim may be created |
| A claim needs to be replaced | the existing claim is resubmitted; no new claim is opened |

**Points of judgement**
- "Open claim per position": two open claims for the same encounter in the same coverage order position do not coexist.
- Example (hypothetical): a patient with three encounters, each billed to one payer, holds three claims; a corrected bill on the second encounter is a resubmission of its existing claim, so the count stays at three.
